BEGIN, thread sequence, INSERT message (origin human)
authorize(Alex, agent.invoke, thread): trigger, operator, mention rule, I2 pre-check
INSERT runs (queued), anchor message kind run, trigger_state received, job runs.queued_expiry
events message.created, run.state_changed, agent.invocation (to the agent, without token)
authorize(Alex without a session, agent.invoke) with current permissions, I2 and SR2 again
sign invocation token (JWS, EdDSA), set runs.invocation_jti, trigger_state queued
signature via JWKS, aud, reported mode equals billing_mode (I3), tool class at most tool_class
event and token into the inbox
POST runs/{id}/invocation-token (old token), checks as before the delivery
check jti, expiry and tool class, CAS queued to running, trigger_state working
apply patch: CAS on runs.version, store without event_log
POST follow-up in the same thread
active run exists: run_followups queued, agent.followup
PrepareDelivery(agent.followup): agent.invoke and I2, new token
POST reply message (origin agent, triggers nothing)
run.finish completed, with metrics and costs
CAS running to completed, summary, cost_entries (estimate), trigger_state done
